name: ncore
description: NCore desktop and web communication platform by NYPTID Industries Advanced Technologies.

scripts.build: npm run audio:assets:sync && npm run audio:voice-cues && vite build
scripts.build:electron:web: npm run audio:assets:sync && set NCORE_ELECTRON_BUILD=1&& vite build
scripts.sync:android:mobile: set CAPACITOR_WEB_DIR=dist-mobile&& npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run build:mobile:web && npm run sync:android:mobile && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:apk:release: npm run build:mobile:web && npm run sync:android:mobile && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.build:exe: npm run icons:sync && npm run build:electron:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.build:exe:portable: npm run icons:sync && npm run build:electron:web && electron-builder --win portable --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.build:tauri:web: npm run audio:assets:sync && npm run audio:voice-cues && node scripts/prepare-tauri-public.cjs && set NCORE_DESKTOP_BUILD=1&& vite build
scripts.build:tauri:release: npm run version:bump && npm run build:tauri && node scripts/sync-tauri-update-feed.cjs
scripts.build:exe:auto:nobump: npm run icons:sync && npm run build:electron:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && node scripts/sync-update-feed.cjs
scripts.build:exe:auto: npm run version:bump && npm run icons:sync && npm run build:electron:web && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && node scripts/sync-update-feed.cjs
scripts.release:update: npm run build:exe:auto && npm run release:web
